title: Revenue Signal Check

storyline.headline: A subscription revenue dip needs a first look
storyline.summary: StreamView's regional lead believes a content launch affected revenue. Open the sales evidence and establish a reliable baseline.

objectives: Load the revenue evidence and inspect the records before making a recommendation.
hints: Business evidence often arrives as a CSV file. pandas reads this into a DataFrame.
Print the table after loading it so you can validate the data.
businessInsight: The first analyst habit is to load and validate evidence before forming an opinion.

handbook.heading: Use pandas for evidence
handbook.whatItDoes: pandas works with labelled rows and columns, like a programmable spreadsheet.
handbook.useCase: Use it to investigate business tables.

handbook.heading: Open a CSV file
handbook.whatItDoes: read_csv turns a CSV file into a DataFrame.
handbook.useCase: Use it to bring evidence into Python.
